integrity: The all-graph theorem is proved by an exact cut inequality; finite exact-integer enumeration corroborates but is not an infinite proof. No claim of authorship attribution, priority certification or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only finite simple unweighted graphs and ambient Euclidean norm; does not cover arbitrary edge weights, other norms, generic two-graph joins, or polytope one-skeleton distance. Possible earlier equivalent formulation under graph orientation/shuffle terminology.
title: Universal Euclidean cone law and farthest-point rigidity for graphical zonotopes
